# Soperator, stage `prod`

The Soperator stack wraps the upstream recipe (`terraform/stacks/soperator`), so this directory
holds only this stage's tfvars layer and its backend config:

```bash
source scripts/bootstrap-backend.sh prod soperator     # bucket per stage, key stages/prod/soperator.tfstate
scripts/fetch-soperator.sh --stage prod                # recipe at the pinned tag + overrides + backend override
cd terraform/stacks/soperator/upstream/soperator/installations/example
terraform plan -var-file=terraform.tfvars \
  -var-file=../../../../profiles/lab.tfvars \
  -var-file=../../../../../../live/prod/soperator/stage.tfvars \
  -var iam_merge_request_url='https://<your-git-host>/.../merge_requests/<id>' -out=soperator-prod.tfplan
```

Var files apply in order: the recipe example, the lab profile, then `stage.tfvars` (last wins).
`production = true` makes the recipe require `iam_merge_request_url`; pass it with `-var` as above
(the recipe's `terraform.tfvars` sets it to an empty string, which beats `TF_VAR_*`).
The mocked plan in CI runs the same three files for every stage.
